expressionReview.timingLabel: Native Studio Edit snapshots at eleven 20 ms phases of the 0.2-second controller blink. GIF and MP4 include 0.8-second open endpoint presentation holds. Reconstructed sampled media, not continuous gameplay footage.
limitations: Only the displayed sampled native blink is assessed. Live gameplay remains untested.

shownAssessments.comment: Quiet breathing, a slow head glance and small ear and tail accents retain the previous resting personality on the new shape. All four paws remain supported and the shell keeps its form. The six-second phrase is restrained and predictable.

At 0.7 studs/s, the four-beat walk shows separate reach, plant and recovery while the shell remains balanced. The whole-paw weights remove the former cuff penetration. Its long support and short recovery suit the heavy round silhouette. Tight turns still slide and are outside this straight-preview pass.

At 16 studs/s the diagonal pairs produce a distinct quick bound, lifted recovery and short support. The 0.202125-second cycle matches travel without a cadence cap, and the face and shell remain stable. The broad belly coat compresses at maximum reach; small-size and faster catch-up cadence remain limitations.

At the nominal 19.14645 studs/s, the longer stride and quicker 0.18119-second cycle read as more urgent pursuit than Walk. Foot recovery clears the floor and the shell stays quiet. This source view omits the native narrowed-lid overlay; actual guardian speed remains player-relative. Turning and acceleration are not passed by this excerpt.

At the displayed 8 studs/s, alternating contralateral paw pairs row through a smooth 1.6-second phrase with a quiet shell and modest paw feathering. The paddle differs from the land gaits. The preview uses the marked review stage rather than water, and the broad shell hides parts of the far-side strokes.

creatures.description: A lively curly-coated companion with soft hanging ears, a sunny crest and feathered wings. Cockapoodle bounds along on four gentle paws, lifting its feathered tail whenever something catches its attention.
creatures.name: Cockapoodle
creatures.notes: The current 3.68-stud Cockapoodle has 2,080 triangles, 21 bones and matte 1K maps. Its backyard egg and existing stats were verified in Studio Edit. The wings and central abdomen keep their shape through the new gait clips. The controller check still measured about 0.086 studs of ground intrusion during a gait change, so the movement remains WIP. Both eyes close and reopen in Studio Edit. At full closure the lid domes stand out from the face and a narrow dark rim remains visible around one eye, so the native Blink remains below the 7.5 pass mark. Cockapoodle switches to its Fly action for water travel. Its dedicated cockatoo-inspired loop scores 8.5/10 at the shown 4.5 studs/s. Ground-motion and Blink limitations remain under review.

review.note: Real model and animations, species egg, four shiny finishes and icons are installed. Assigned-biome wild eggs are enabled. Daniel model/animation approval and live gameplay acceptance remain pending.

creatures.notes: The current 4.5-stud Flamingoat has 2,176 triangles, 21 bones and matte 1K maps. Its Farmland egg and existing stats were verified in Studio Edit. The body-parented hooves retain the planted stance and the 16-stud/s Run review speed. The thin leg joints flex sharply at the fastest gather, so Run remains WIP. Both eyes close and reopen in Studio Edit. Raised eyelid domes and a pale crescent remain visible at full closure, so the native Blink is below the 7.5 pass mark.

shownAssessments.comment: The supported stance stays quiet while a small neck dip, eased glance and tail response keep the long phrase alive. The face, feathered body and four complete hooves retain their shapes. The phrase has limited variation. Fine ankle cuffs remain soft, and this skeletal preview does not include Blink or native facial overlays.

shownAssessments.comment: At 16 studs/s, the longer fore-pair and hind-pair bound has readable extension, flight and folded recovery. The 2.771 cycles/s cadence keeps the torso and neck controlled while the ground passes at the declared speed. The brief contact window is stylized and fine cuffs still compress through recovery. This straight cycle does not approve the separately held state blends or turning contact.

Start, stop and pivot-turn contact remain held in the separate movement assessment.

nativeFootPlantTrial.scope: Local replay of actual native Play bone-world samples, resampled at 15 FPS. Body skin and source colour only; facial cosmetic parts, native PBR lighting and physics are omitted. This is not a Play screen recording. Walking speed: 1.1 studs/s, at 3.5 studs height. Replay is 15 FPS.
nativeFootPlantTrial.performanceNote: The six-creature desktop fixture used two of each species. Median whole-frame time was about 16.71 ms with IK disabled and 16.74 ms enabled. Median measured script body-update time rose from about 0.711 to 0.785 ms. These small isolated samples do not establish mobile or multiplayer cost.

historicalReplacementImports.notes: Animation repair, 31 October 2026: The existing installed body is retained; the repaired joint candidate remains held locally. Idle 5.5, Run 3, Walk 4 (shown previews). Straight contacts improve, but turning still slides. The 16 and 24 studs/s Run cases demand 14.109 and 21.164 cycles/s and remain below quality acceptance. A current Roblox Studio Edit image is recorded on this page. Current GIF/MP4 copies and the repair report are on this creature page. Saved developer votes are unchanged; saving, publication and live acceptance remain separate. Release update, 28 October 2026: the real creature model, animations, intact species egg, Standard artwork, Fine/Superior/Epic/Legendary finishes, transparent actual-shell egg icon and existing transparent creature portrait are registered. Wild eggs are enabled in the assigned biome at ordinary initialization and dawn. Current sizes, mass, rarity, income, nest homes, five-minute player-count allocation and guardian models are retained. Source checks, installed readback and detached Edit egg rolls passed; gameplay, multiplayer, mobile and real storage/rejoin remain pending. Saving and publication remain Daniel-owned. Earlier stage notes: The supplied crab and raccoon-like FBX was imported as Crabuki through the native API on 28 October 2026. Its template and Home preview retain all triangles and all 40 supplied bones plus PetRoot, with the original colour texture. The invalid duplicate colour image in the normal slot is omitted. Skin weights are converted to Roblox four-influence limits. Its eight walking legs use gentle alternating motion; claws and face keep their supplied pose. Edit skinning, resizing and front/side/walking checks passed. The original source is copied into creatures/6-rainbow-coral-reef/crabuki/crabuki.fbx. Deployed species catalogue and wild egg integration remain pending. Live deformation and gameplay acceptance remain pending. No manual save or publication was performed. Following animation update, 28 October 2026: idle movement and fitted blinking are installed and verified on the native model under plan 04b25d3ca0534bf09f8f3776dcdddc60. Evidence: output/follower-idle-all. Live following and animation acceptance remain pending.

shownAssessments.comment: At 0 studs/s: The face, shell and separated claw shapes stay readable, with a small head and body movement that keeps the creature alive. The repeated motion is slight and mechanical, without a purposeful pause, clear supported settle or much secondary claw and leg response. It remains below the body polish threshold.
shownAssessments.reviewScope: Current offline shown preview. Full movement and developer approval remain separate.

shownAssessments.comment: At 16 studs/s: The tucked posture and larger leg changes distinguish the action from the slower Walk, and the head remains readable. At 16 stud/s the retained short stride repeats about 13.02 cycles/s. The crowded legs flicker and churn beneath a comparatively rigid body, with no convincing weight transfer or readable footfalls. At 50 fps there are fewer than 4 frames per cycle, which also limits contact inspection.
shownAssessments.reviewScope: Current offline shown preview. Full movement and developer approval remain separate.

shownAssessments.comment: At 2.1181 studs/s: The face and shell remain stable and the visible walking branches stay recognisable through the slow cycle. At 2.1181 stud/s, the small leg shuffle does not convincingly support the sustained travel. The body appears to glide relative to the ground marks, with little readable loading and recovery in this view.
shownAssessments.reviewScope: Current offline shown preview. Full movement and developer approval remain separate.

When following, it flies while the player walks or while it catches up, then lands and idles once the player and follower stop on supported dry ground. It stays airborne over water until a dry landing is available; its usual Grounded locomotion default remains intact. Nine installed-source garden Edit fixture runs and seven follower Edit fixture runs passed at 30/60 Hz and 0.75/1/1.25 scale, including garden interruptions and a controlled wet stop. These photographs show temporary native Edit fixtures; the current-height GIF/MP4 clips are local renders of the existing skin and motions. Real garden traversal, multiplayer and mobile performance remain separate acceptance checks. The retained 7 November previews were rendered at 3.4 studs. Their original scores and files are historical; this garden behavior update does not regrade them or change saved developer votes.
